title: Kan Mallattoo Isaa Fuulduratti Mootummaan Tokko Sagade
intro: Warra iccitii kana furuuf ija jabaatan imala ajaa'ibaatu eeggata. Fuula Mul’ata keessa gad fageenyaan, abbaan biyyaa raajii tokkoo wajjin wal arguun isaa saba guutuu irra deebi’ee bocu tokko jira ture. Fakkiin kun teessoo fagoo irraa, duudhaa duriitiin qajeelfamee, hanga yeroon addaa dhugaan waaqummaa bulchaa fi mootummaa bara baraan jijjiirutti bulchaa ture. Eenyummaa lubbuu dinqisiisaa seenaan ishee waan addaa fi gadi fagoo riqicha godhu kanaa ni saaxiltaa?
clues: Bishaan fagoo, iddoo biqiltuu keenyaa fi masaraa olkaʼaa taʼeen kan beekamu, saba badhaadhina qabu tokkon bulcha ture.
Aangoon koo ol’aanaa ture, ta’us mootummaan guddaan jiraachuu fi eenyummaa keenya mormuuf dhufe.
Simbirroon xiqqoo tokko ergaa adda taʼe kan qabatte siʼa taʼu, dinqiiwwan sana booda uumaman immoo waaʼee aangoo ilaalchisee tilmaama ani qabu hunda caccabse.
Teessoo ija koo duratti jijjiirame yeroon argu, namni du’u kamiyyuu dandeettii akkasii qabaachuu akka hin dandeenye nan beeka ture.
Waan yeroo tokko akkan jaalladhu hunda dhiisee, Gooftaa tokkicha samii fi lafaatiif bitamuu koo ifatti labse.
Nuti akka sabaatti waaqeffannaa aduu durii irraa garagalchinee dhugaa waan hunda jijjiire fudhanne.

Teessoo kootti deebi'ee akkuma duraanii bulchuu itti fufe
Sabni booji’amee impaayera biraa keessatti liqimfame

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
